args.title: checkout-api health check failures after v2.3.1 deploy

trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Diagnosed**: checkout-api v2.3.1 was overwhelmed with error-rate (~18%) and failing health checks across all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Release history confirmed v2.3.1 was the healthy-breaker; v2.3.0 was the most recent healthy production release.
2. **Rolled back**: Deployed checkout-api **v2.3.0** to all production regions — rollout complete in us-east, us-west, and eu-west.
3. **Opened incident**: Created **INC-0001** (SEV2, status open) describing the failure and the rollback; the on-call engineer has been paged.
